prompt:
Workflow step: Use the mobile robot to move the mold from material station to mobile robot platform.
Inspection timing: before this step
Inspection location: material station
What the inspection checks: Check whether the mold is on material station.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: A tiered white lab rack holds pigment and silicone bottles on a metal rail with white circular holders.

Front row, left to right: a squeeze bottle of dark brown/near-black liquid with a white pointed cap, upright in its holder; a bottle of dark teal-green liquid with a white pointed nozzle cap, upright; a bottle of very dark, near-black liquid with a dark pointed nozzle, upright; and at far right a partly visible white-capped bottle.

Behind them, a back row of taller white bottles stands upright with red, yellow, and white flip-top caps, all closed, plus a clear/translucent tube-like container at upper left.

Purple-and-white labels with QR codes read "Mold 1," "Mold 2," "Mold 3," "Sil-Pigment Green," "Sil-Pigment Black," "Dragon skin," and "DC184-A."
observations: The inspection observed pigment and silicone bottles but did not identify the presence of a mold on the material station.
